title: Answer: phenomenal consciousness, constituted at least partly by quiddities

statements.text: Consciousness here means phenomenal consciousness, there being something it is like to have an experience. It is constituted at least partly by the quiddities that ground the dispositions of fundamental physics.

sources.quote: throughout, all references to consciousness refer to phenomenal consciousness
According to Russellian monism, consciousness is constituted at least partly by quiddities
